description: Details of All new work and improvements inside and outside the building must match existing original adjacent work in terms of the choice of materials, method of construction and finished appearance; All new roof coverings, including leadwork and pitched roof elements; masonry repairs; Extent of fabric removal limited;  No new plumbing; Sample panels of all new or repaired facing brickwork showing the proposed brick types, colour, texture, face bond and pointing ; The extent and scope of render repair or replacement; Cleaning methodology and appearance including approval of cleaning trials; details and composition of proposed grouts should be agreed on site; and Any requirement replacement external rainwater goods and/or soil pipes shall be like for like pursuant to conditions 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, and 10 of listed building consent dated 13th August 2026 (RN  26/03978/LBC)
